definitions.explanation: A mistake caused by carelessness or lack of attention rather than lack of knowledge or ability. Implies the error was easily avoidable.

examples.english: I lost points due to a careless mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{凡|ぼん}ミス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つけ⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.english: You make a lot of careless calculation errors, so be careful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{凡|ぼん}ミス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連発|れんぱつ}して→連発する：21028_renpatsusuru⟧しまい、⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけた→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: I made one careless mistake after another in an important match and caused trouble for the team.

notes:
USAGE:
A hybrid word combining the kanji {凡|ぼん} (ordinary, mediocre) with the English loanword ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧ (miss/mistake). Very common in school, sports, and work contexts. Often used self-critically.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {凡|ぼん}ミス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make a careless mistake
- {凡|ぼん}ミス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{減|へ}らす→減らす：02414_herasu⟧: to reduce careless mistakes
- {凡|ぼん}ミス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目立|めだ}つ→目立つ：02431_medatsu⟧: careless mistakes stand out
- {凡|ぼん}ミス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{連発|れんぱつ}する→連発する：21028_renpatsusuru⟧: to make careless mistakes in succession
